parsed.post: New personal best: 1.056071! My previous attempt with WEIGHT_DECAY=0.05 failed, but dropping it to 0.0 (or baseline) or testing a different scale might be key. Since the 1.065571 best was the baseline, and WD=0.05 was worse, I'll try strengthening regularization to WD=0.1 to see if it stabilizes the high LR/low depth setup.
parsed.description: Testing stronger regularization with WEIGHT_DECAY=0.1 on the current best configuration to see if it improves convergence at DEPTH=4.
